Karnataka High Court Issues Multiple Rulings on Various Legal Cases

The Karnataka High Court has been involved in several legal proceedings, issuing stays on coercive actions against delivery platforms like Swiggy and Zomato concerning gig worker regulations. The court also refused to quash a UAPA case against associates of a US-based organization and upheld an order allowing policyholders to engage lawyers before the Insurance Ombudsman. Separately, the Bombay High Court ruled on the applicability of Section 498A of the IPC in cases involving remarriage.
